messages:
Camila Reyes: :mega: Launching our *internal Customer Reference Request* process (effective today)

Goal: make it easy + consistent to (1) request reference calls and (2) recruit customers for public case studies (logo/quotes/metrics) without overloading CS relationships.

If you need a reference for an active deal or want to nominate a customer for the case study program, please use the process below — *no more ad hoc asks directly to customers*.

*1) Read the playbook (eligibility, incentives, permissions, and how we use references):*
https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SE/Customer+Reference+Program+Overview

*2) Submit a request via the intake template (takes ~3–5 min):*
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rwd-refs-intake ("Customer Reference Request - Intake Template")

*3) What happens next (SLA + approvals):*
- Tyler (Mktg Ops) routes the request within 1 business day
- Required approvals before we contact the customer: *CSM + AE + Legal* (logo/quote/metrics requests)
- Please plan for *5–7 business days lead time* for scheduling (faster if customer has already opted in)

*Quick guardrails (important):*
- Do not contact / do not surprise: if a customer is marked "DNC" or in cooldown, we won’t reach out
- Reference load: default cap is *2 reference calls/month per customer* unless CS approves more
- Public case study ≠ reference call: public assets require signed consent + brand/legal review window

We’ll track all requests + outcomes in HubSpot so we can measure utilization and pipeline influence.

Questions / help: reply here or ping #customer-references (new).

Thanks everyone — we’re targeting 3–5 committed design partners over the next 8–10 weeks. :tada:

Tyler Benson: Added: the intake template includes fields for *deal stage, target go-live date, competitor context, and "what we need to prove"* so we can prep the customer properly. If you’re not sure what to put, drop the rough context and we’ll follow up.

Rachel Kim: +1 on not DM’ing customers with a reference ask. If you’ve already planted the seed with an exec sponsor, still submit the intake so we can log it + make sure the CSM is aligned on timing.

Stephanie Nguyen: Love this. Sales ask: please include the *exact prospect profile* (industry + why they’re similar) in the intake — it helps us pick the best customer match and avoid awkward calls.

Soojin Lee: FYI for case study asks: we’ll default to *ranges* for metrics unless we have explicit approval for exact numbers. The playbook has the approved claim language + proof requirements.

Markus Klein: For teams requesting a technical validation / architecture diagram for a story, add it in the intake under “Supporting assets.” SE can usually turn a first pass in 3–5 biz days once we have the deployment details.

Isabelle Laurent: Reporting note: we’ll start tagging deals that used (a) a reference call and/or (b) a case study link. If you share a customer story in an email thread, please log it so we can attribute influence.

Miguel Santos: Also: if you think a customer is a good candidate but you’re worried about burden / recent escalations, flag that in the intake (“relationship risk”). CS will sanity check health before we proceed.

Ethan Wallace: For anyone nominating a customer for a public writeup: if you have existing quotes from emails/calls, paste them into the intake (with context). We’ll still re-approve with the customer, but it speeds up drafting.

Camila Reyes: Thanks all. Next up: we’ll share a weekly list of (1) open requests, (2) scheduled calls, and (3) customers in approval for public assets. If you submit something urgent, note the deadline and we’ll do our best — but we’re going to protect customer experience first.
